canvas.title: Uppsala store guide
canvas.markdown:
# Uppsala store guide

Welcome to Norrhem Livs Uppsala. Your work is in Slack. These are the channels and the rules for this store.

## Contacts

| Who | Role | Channel |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Morgan | Store manager | #store-uppsala |
| Facilities | Fridges, freezers, doors | #food-safety |
| Harry | Regional ops, Mitt | #region-mitt |

## Cold chain

- Fridges stay at 0–5°C. Freezers stay at −18°C or colder.
- At 8°C or higher, move the stock and run Report an issue in #food-safety.
- Leave the reading and the new location in the thread for the next shift.

## Allergens

- Unlabelled prep does not go on the shelf.
- A spill of a major allergen is a food-safety issue.

## Before your first shift

Run Complete my induction from the bookmark in #onboarding. Tick the food-safety sign-off.

limits: Frontline Members cannot use Slackbot, create canvases or lists, or start huddles.
Frontline Members can run workflows and open content a Full Member shares in their channels.
Do not show or claim QR sign-in, native shift scheduling, or off-shift blocking.
checks: The Frontline add-on is on, and Linnea is a Frontline Member.
Acknowledge and the three bookmarked workflows work as Linnea on a phone.
Linnea can open the onboarding canvas on a phone.
Beat 1 is pre-recorded as a fallback.
Morgan and Harry use separate Chrome profiles, and phone mirroring has been tested.

manualSteps.title: Install the workspace app on the Enterprise Grid org
manualSteps.detail: Create a Slack app from slack/manifest.json and install it on the Enterprise Grid org, not on a single workspace. Grant it to workspaces created later, and approve it if an admin must. This app creates the demo workspace and stages channels. People do not message it. Skip this when that org install already exists.

manualSteps.title: Store the org-admin Slack token
manualSteps.detail: Keep the org-admin user token in the coding agent's secret store as SLACK_ADMIN_TOKEN. Persona tokens use SLACK_TOKEN_LINNEA, SLACK_TOKEN_MORGAN, SLACK_TOKEN_HARRY, and the same pattern for Johan, Erik, Sara, Noah, Maj, and Samir. The agent uses them to create the workspace and post the staged lines. Keep them out of git. Skip a token when it is already stored.

manualSteps.title: Make Linnea a Frontline Member
manualSteps.detail: Turn on the Frontline add-on. Linnea is a Frontline Member with exactly #store-uppsala, #region-mitt, #food-safety, #announcements, and #onboarding, and she is out of #general and #random. Morgan and Harry are Full Members. Harry is in every store channel. Create an @facilities user group. Use separate Chrome profiles for Morgan and Harry, and test phone mirroring for Linnea. Do this before the webinar. The live demo does not include an admin invite.

manualSteps.title: Build the workflows and test them on a phone
manualSteps.detail: In Workflow Builder, create Complete my induction, Report an issue, and End-of-shift handover from the forms in the plan, and bookmark each one in its channel. Create Acknowledge as a one-tap workflow and put that link on the price-change button. Test all four as Linnea on a phone, and open the onboarding canvas on that phone. Then re-run the seed so the bookmarks and the button use those links.

manualSteps.title: Post any staged lines the tokens did not send
manualSteps.detail: Each staged message is posted as that person. Where a persona token is missing, sign in as that person and paste the line from the dry-run. Leave Linnea's fridge 4 reply unsent until Morgan has replied in the thread. Put the fridge 4 photo in Linnea's camera roll before the webinar.

manualSteps.title: Pre-record Linnea's beat
manualSteps.detail: Record Beat 1 on the phone as a fallback before the webinar. The live path is still Linnea in Slack, with no huddle.

agentSteps.title: Confirm the Enterprise Grid org
agentSteps.detail: Use the Slack Enterprise+ org with the Frontline add-on. Create a new workspace on that org. This demo is Slack only.

agentSteps.title: Workspace Norrhem Livs
agentSteps.detail: Create a workspace named Norrhem Livs with admin.teams.create. Use team_domain norrhem-livs. The app is already installed on the Enterprise Grid org and granted to new workspaces. Pass the new workspace id as team_id on later calls.

agentSteps.title: Create the channels
agentSteps.detail: Create 9 channels with admin.conversations.create in the new workspace. Linnea's home is store-uppsala, region-mitt, food-safety, announcements, onboarding. She is not a member of the other store channels.

agentSteps.title: Add Morgan's onboarding canvas
agentSteps.detail: Create the canvas "Uppsala store guide" with canvases.create as Morgan, tabbed into #onboarding. Frontline Members can open a canvas a Full Member shares. They do not create one.

agentSteps.title: Post the staged history
agentSteps.detail: Post each staged message with that person's user token. Thread the store acknowledgements under Harry's price-change message. Leave Linnea's moved reply unsent.

agentSteps.title: Bookmark the three workflows
agentSteps.detail: When the Workflow Builder links exist, bookmarks.add Complete my induction in #onboarding, Report an issue in #food-safety, and End-of-shift handover in #store-uppsala. Acknowledge stays a button on the price-change message.

agentSteps.title: Save the spec
agentSteps.detail: Write this plan to demos/norrhem-livs.json. Put the Slack workspace id, channel ids, and message timestamps only in demos/norrhem-livs.links.json.

agentSteps.title: Hand off the live demo
agentSteps.detail: Stop here. Norrhem Livs opens with Linnea already in Slack. Do not run an admin invite on stage, and do not start a huddle.

talkTrack.label: Beat 1
talkTrack.say: No company email, no sidebar of 40 channels. HQ decided what she needs on day one.

talkTrack.label: Beat 2
talkTrack.say: The canvas is the store guide. The workflow is the food-safety sign-off.

talkTrack.label: Beat 3
talkTrack.say: HQ pushed this at 08:45, and every store got it on the phone in their pocket.

talkTrack.label: Beat 4
talkTrack.say: That's now with Morgan and facilities.

talkTrack.label: Beat 5
talkTrack.say: The evening shift inherits the fridge, the dairy delivery, and the price labels.

talkTrack.label: Switch
talkTrack.say: Now let's see what that looks like for her store manager.

talkTrack.label: Beat 6
talkTrack.say: A full audit trail for food safety, on a governed platform rather than WhatsApp. Nothing gets lost between shifts.

talkTrack.label: Switch
talkTrack.say: And at HQ, with 40 stores, Harry needs the bigger picture.

talkTrack.label: Beat 7
talkTrack.say: The frontline doesn't need AI on their phones for HQ to get AI-level visibility of the floor.

talkTrack.label: Close
talkTrack.say: One Enterprise+ security layer covers the whole workforce, with up to 10 channels per worker, accounts that expire for seasonal staff, and SCIM provisioning. The Bryd fixed-scope Frontline launch includes the Enterprise+ migration where it is needed, with a December start.
